extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers/contributors attempting to create a new article (new or unregistered users and autoconfirmed editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and procedural requirements for creating a new Wikipedia article (how to check for existing pages, account and confirmation requirements, title rules, and what to do if a page was deleted or not visible).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for existing articles / alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for Comedy Latin America in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings to avoid duplication. The page suggests using the search box and checking similar titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New users must register and reach autoconfirmed status before creating pages. If you cannot create an article directly, alternatives include using the article wizard, submitting a draft for review, or requesting a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard / submit draft / request new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you lack the permissions or are unsure about creating a full article, follow the article wizard or draft submission process so more experienced editors can review and help publish the content; you can also request that someone create the article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect backlinks to see whether the topic is mentioned elsewhere and whether a redirect or article might already exist under a different name; this helps determine notability and existing coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page visibility delays / purge function
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When a newly created page does not appear, wait briefly for replication to complete or use the purge action to force an update; do not immediately assume the page is absent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify capitalization and other orthographic variants; create redirects where appropriate so users searching different capitalizations or spellings reach the canonical article.

rubrics_metrics.name: If deleted, check the deletion log and deletion reasons
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the deletion log to learn whether the title was removed and why; follow the guidance in 'Why was the page I created deleted?' to understand deletion reasons and how to address them (e.g., notability, sourcing, or content issues).
